author: Mark Atwood
text:
SEVERITY MAPPING 2026-05-12 (cascade from PKIX-jy95.2 = B): bridge crate emits ZlintLintInfo with severity drawn from zlint's catalog metadata, mapped to pkix-lint Severity as follows:

- zlint notice -> Severity::Notice (new variant, added via PKIX-jy95.2.1)
- zlint warning -> Severity::Warn
- zlint error -> Severity::Error
- zlint fatal -> Severity::Fatal

Per-cert verdict -> LintResult (separately, applied by the adapter's dynamic Lint impls reading bridge cache):

- NA (Not Applicable) -> LintResult::NotApplicable
- NE (Not Effective) -> LintResult::NotApplicable
- Pass -> LintResult::Pass
- Notice/Warn/Error/Fatal -> LintResult::error(detail from zlint output)

The Finding's emitted severity is the Lint's declared severity (from zlint catalog at enumeration time), NOT the per-cert verdict level -- each zlint check has a fixed source severity per zlint's catalog. The per-cert verdict only determines whether the Lint fires.

DEPENDENCY: this bridge work waits for PKIX-jy95.2.1 to land (extend pkix-lint Severity with Notice variant) before it can use the Notice variant in metadata.
